business_problem: Since 2023, the company's client-centric and people-first approachand drive for innovation have catalyzed significant growth. UST expanded into 34 countries and hired thousands of technical experts, including 2,000 entry-level engineers.
solution_summary: Since 2023, the company's client-centric and people-first approachand drive for innovation have catalyzed significant growth. UST expanded into 34 countries and hired thousands of technical experts, including 2,000 entry-level engineers. Rapid growth catalyzed the need for UST to better manage and integrate employee data across diverse regions and systems. UST built a comprehensive, unified Employee Data platform on Microsoft Fabric. UST eliminated the need for separate data pipelines for each entity, enhancing data accessibility and employee productivity and enabling a self-service model that removes gatekeeping and promotes data-driven decision-making. With an ethos of transforming lives through technology, UST Global entwines its core values of humanity, humility, and integrity into every interaction with customers and in its employee support.

solution_components.name: Azure Data Factory
solution_components.role: Orchestrates and ingests data pipelines from operational source systems into the analytics platform.

solution_components.name: Azure Synapse Analytics
solution_components.role: Unifies large-scale SQL, lake, and analytics workloads for enterprise reporting and data engineering.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Fabric
solution_components.role: Provides the shared data platform for storing, governing, and analyzing enterprise data across teams.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Publishes dashboards and reports so teams can monitor operations and act on live insights.

solution_components.name: Power Apps
solution_components.role: Delivers low-code business applications that expose the new workflows to employees and partners.
